cases.why: Two short answers ("brute force", "two pointer technique") and a Finish after an open tutor question (PLAN_08). "Scan in array order" was only ever the tutor's: it may be credited with a nudge, never as their own words, and the approach must not be "Reverse compare scan". The tutor's "go through the words one by one" may or may not count as stating "check in order, return the first", so pass and borderline are both honest.
